requirement.title: AI Recruitment Automation Platform
requirement.author: DuyMT
requirement.description: Automated multi-tenant SaaS platform for recruitment agencies to streamline end-to-end hiring workflows. Multi-client architecture with data isolation, semantic candidate matching, CV screening, interview scheduling, objective test scoring, pipeline management, and JP/VN/EN translation.
requirement.problemStatement: Recruitment agencies manually handle candidate sourcing, CV screening, interview scheduling, test scoring, and content generation — processes that are time-consuming, error-prone, and inconsistent across clients. An automated recruitment platform is needed to streamline the recruitment lifecycle, reduce time-to-hire, and improve candidate quality across multiple agency clients.

context.businessContext: Recruitment agencies serving multiple employer clients need to process high volumes of candidates efficiently while maintaining quality and compliance. AI automation can reduce manual overhead by 40-60%.
context.targetMarket: Small-to-medium recruitment agencies (5-100 recruiters) serving B2B employer clients, with focus on Japan-Vietnam-English markets
context.deploymentModel: Cloud-based SaaS, multi-tenant architecture on GCP

primaryUsers.description: Manages agency settings, clients, billing, and user permissions
Day-to-day operator: posts jobs, screens candidates, schedules interviews, manages multiple client accounts
Conducts interviews (live or AI-assisted), reviews automated scores
External job seeker interacting via portal and chatbot
Views pipeline dashboards, provides feedback, approves hires
Reviews AI-generated translations (JP/VN/EN) when confidence is low

agencyDataModel.description: Core entity model for recruitment agency operations with multi-client support

features.name: Candidate Sourcing
features.description: Multi-channel candidate search across job boards, LinkedIn, and internal databases with semantic matching, ranking based on weighted criteria (skills, experience, organizational preference signals), and automated outreach messaging to top candidates.
features.aiPipeline: CV Parse → Embedding → Vector Search → Weighted Scoring → Match Score
acceptanceCriteria: AI matching score accuracy > 85% vs manual recruiter assessment
Automated outreach sent within 5 minutes of match

features.name: CV Parsing & Screening
features.description: Resume/CV parsing from PDF and DOCX with structured data extraction, screening using weighted scoring and vector similarity against job requirements, explainable scoring, and duplicate detection across client pools.
features.aiPipeline: Document parsing → Entity extraction → Semantic matching → Scoring
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate detection across all client candidate pools

features.name: Interview Scheduling
features.description: Calendar integration (Google/Outlook), automatic availability collection and matching for candidate/interviewer/panel, multi-round scheduling, automated reminders, timezone-aware scheduling with priority on JP/VN/EN timezones.

schedulingLogic.availabilityCollection: Candidate provides preferred slots via portal; interviewer sets availability windows; system reads calendar events via OAuth API
schedulingLogic.slotSuggestionAlgorithm: Find overlapping availability, prioritize within 48h, respect business hours (9:00-18:00 local per participant), suggest top 3 ranked by urgency and preferences
schedulingLogic.timezoneSupport: All times stored in UTC, displayed in local timezone, auto-detect from candidate location/IP, primary support: JST (JP), ICT (VN), multiple EN zones

acceptanceCriteria: Support phone screen, technical, and onsite rounds

features.name: Assessment Scoring (Objective Only)
features.scope: MVP ONLY — objective question types only
features.description: Configurable MCQ assessments with predefined answer scoring, threshold-based pass/fail, instant results, and recruiter override capability.
scoringFlow: Auto-grading engine evaluates MCQ/short answers → Instant score
Score vs threshold comparison → Pass/fail determination
AI-generated score breakdown → Attached to application
acceptanceCriteria: Score available within 5 seconds of submission
Recruiter override capability for edge cases

features.name: Pipeline Management
features.description: Visual pipeline/kanban board with configurable stages, client-specific workflows, drag-and-drop configuration, automated transitions, and real-time dashboard metrics.

configurableStages.autoTransition: If AI score ≥ threshold OR recruiter override
At any stage by decision or auto-fail

acceptanceCriteria: Real-time dashboard with candidate count by stage

features.name: Translation (JP/VN/EN)
features.description: LLM-based translation for CVs, interview feedback, and job descriptions across Japanese, Vietnamese, and English with human review queue for low-confidence outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Translation available for JP, VN, EN language pairs

features.name: Email & Notifications
features.description: Template-based email system with automated notifications for candidates, recruiters, and clients. Agency branding support.
acceptanceCriteria: Email sent within 60 seconds of trigger event

features.name: RBAC & Authentication
features.description: Role-based access control with email/password authentication, optional SSO, and multi-factor authentication.

features.name: Multi-Client Data Isolation
features.description: Recruiter manages multiple client companies with strict data isolation. Client-scoped jobs, candidates, and applications. Shared candidate pool with deduplication.
acceptanceCriteria: Recruiter can switch between managed clients
Data scoped to active client context

required.name: Email System
required.purpose: Candidate notifications, recruiter alerts, client updates

required.name: AI Provider
required.purpose: CV parsing, embedding, matching, scoring, translation
required.fallbackStrategy: If primary provider fails, automatically route to fallback provider

aiArchitecture.mvpPipeline: CV Parse → Embedding (OpenAI/Sentence-Transformers) → Vector Search (pgvector/Pinecone) → Weighted Scoring (skills 40%, exp 30%, edu 20%, org preference 10%) → Optional Translation → Optional Summarization

security.rbac: Per-entity level access control with 5 distinct roles
security.authentication: Email/password + optional SSO (Google, Microsoft) + optional MFA
security.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
security.auditLogging: All candidate data access logged with who, what, when, IP, device

scalability: Multi-tenant architecture with data isolation per agency
Horizontal scaling for AI processing via BullMQ queue
Database read replicas for analytics queries
reliability: Fallback to rule-based processing when LLM services are unavailable
Health check endpoints for all critical services

cvParseFail.userMessage: We couldn't fully parse your resume. Please review the extracted fields below and correct any errors.
cvParseFail.systemAction: Show editable extracted fields, allow manual override, queue for retry

aiUnavailable.userMessage: Our AI service is temporarily busy. Your request has been queued and will be processed within 2 minutes.
aiUnavailable.systemAction: Show estimated wait time, degrade to rule-based processing

calendarSyncFail.userMessage: We couldn't connect to your calendar. Please check your connection and try again.
calendarSyncFail.systemAction: Retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts), manual entry fallback

translationFail.userMessage: Translation service is temporarily unavailable. Original text is displayed.
translationFail.systemAction: Fallback to source language, queue for retry, manual translation option

generalPrinciples: Always show original data when AI services fail
Never block the user — provide manual fallback for every automated step
Log all failures with full context
Retry with exponential backoff, max 3 attempts
Toast/notification for transient errors, inline for persistent issues

aiLayer.fallbackStrategy: Queue for retry, then graceful degradation to rule-based

resolvedOpenQuestions.question: Which specific AI cloud provider should power the AI features?
Multi-tenancy depth — branded client portals or unified view?
resolvedOpenQuestions.resolution: Single workspace with client-scoped data isolation

resolvedOpenQuestions.question: Expected monthly budget for AI APIs and infrastructure?
resolvedOpenQuestions.resolution: $500–$1,500/month — determines model selection, caching strategy, rate limits

resolvedOpenQuestions.question: Deployment target: Cloud, VPS, or self-hosted?
Existing data to migrate from other systems?
